challengeTypes: identify: On a number line, to ADD we hop... (Forward vs Backward vs Up)
sort: Drag addition problems to the right answer (3+4=7 | 5+5=10 | 2+6=8 | 9+3=12)
identify: On a number line, to SUBTRACT we hop... (Backward vs Forward vs Down)
sort: Drag subtraction problems to the right answer (8-3=5 | 10-4=6 | 9-2=7 | 12-5=7)
sort: Drag mixed problems to addition or subtraction (Addition: 3+4, 5+5, 2+6 | Subtraction: 8-3, 10-4, 9-2)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Addition is putting two groups together and counting all. (2) Subtraction is taking some away. (3) Number line — hop forward to add, hop backward to subtract. (4) Count on: 3+4 means start at 3, count 4 more: 4,5,6,7. (5) Count back: 8-3 means start at 8, count back 3: 7,6,5. Misconceptions: "adding means any bigger number" (the sum must be the exact count), "subtraction always gives 1" (subtraction takes away the stated amount), "subtract bigger from smaller" (always start with the bigger number). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AdditionGame), NOT export default. Export interface AdditionGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
